name: Hermisende (Spain)
description: Divided into three diagonal parts from the lower hoist to the upper fly, green at the upper hoist, red in the centre and blue at the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Hermisende.
history: Municipal flag of Hermisende; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: broad diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
Hermisende arms — tower and tree on green, a bridge on red above waves
